ns2:course.label: Marching Band Procedures
ns2:course.description: Detailed consideration of principles and procedures for preparing a marching band to participate in parades, ceremonials, and shows for sports events. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in instrumental music education.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in instrumental music education.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
